accepted.question_text: Obtain Erdős–Lehner type asymptotic distributions for statistics arising in generalizations of Rogers–Ramanujan-type identities, especially for the CMMP conjectures, and in particular determine the distribution of the lengths of CMMP partitions of n as n tends to infinity.

evidence.quote:

tions of Roger–Ramanujan-type identities, in particular, for the CMMP conjectures [5]. That
is, obtain the distribution of lengths of CMMP-partitions of n as n → ∞.

accepted.question_text: For each n, let P_n(z) be the polynomial in z given by the coefficient of q^n in the infinite product ∏_{m≥1}(1-q^m)^{-z}. Study the zeros of these polynomials, and also the zeros of analogous polynomials attached to CMMP partitions and related constructions, including whether there is a Riemann-hypothesis-type description of their zero sets.

evidence.quote:
Question 6 (Ken Ono,  Q inspired by a talk of Bernhard Heim). Define polynomials in z as the
coefficients of q n in m≥1 (1 − q m )−z . What can be said about the zeros of such polynomials,
and of similarly defined polynomials associated to CMMP partitions, etc. Is there a Riemann
hypothesis?
